items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I charged him a dollar. The same for Joe Nickles. And Mealy Bone and them. They're taking the job for six bits.

ctx.x: I remember once. I got a little job there for this lottery man. Hawks. That jury man. On Street. He had a little dance. He said, you know how the band to come play that around. For his lottery. I think. I charged him a dollar. The same for Joe Nickles. And Mealy Bone and them. They're taking the job for six bits. I said, it's time to quit now.
